Definition: Mechujael or Mechijael, an antediluvian patriarch
BiblicalUsage: Mehujael is the son of Irad and the father of Methusael, on the line of Cain. The line runs from Enoch to Lamech, building cities and making swords while Seth's line called on the name of the LORD.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Cain's line is the record of a world getting on without God: cities, music, and metal, all of it real, and all of it ending in Lamech's boast — while the other line simply called on the LORD.
RelatedPeople: Enoch; Irad; Lamech, Son of Methusael; Cain
